> 第四章 又是一剑（第1页）
河南开封县内有一处市镇名作青松坡，而使得这青松坡闻名江湖的是这里有一座山庄叫“快活林”。在快活林里，如果你想吃顿好的，这里的厨子烧出得菜绝不会比京城八福记酒楼烧出的菜差。如果你想找女人，这里的女人也不会比苏州怡红院的小姐差到那去，甚至更有其它风韵。当然这里还有最大的赌场，赌场内什么都有，骰子、麻将、牌九、斗鸡等，就连下棋也可以有人在赌。总之，这快活林便是有钱人一等一的销金窟。
快活林的当家韩猛此刻正坐在一张太师椅上，沏了一壶茶，是上好的六安瓜片，喝了两盅，然而心情还是没有好起来。韩猛有一种爱好，喜欢收集一些奇珍古玩，因为有钱在江湖中有地位，所以有不少人巴结他，收集了不少好东西。单就十日之前所买得一只玉麒麟来说，浑身透绿，是翡翠中的极品。尤其是嘴里所含的一颗夜明珠，圆润光滑，夜里闪闪发光，一间小屋照得跟白昼一般，极为珍贵。就连宫内御用监主管王公公看了之后也不禁称奇，连称少有！
然而也有不给面子的。听说苍南剑客岳千重家中有一把“鱼肠剑”，乃春秋时留下的奇兵，韩猛特地带上十万两银子求购。刚到府上岳千重自是热情招待，然一听说要求购鱼肠剑，脸色一变，道：“鱼肠剑乃家传之物，再多的银子也不卖!”最后不欢而散，韩猛悻悻而归。
韩猛越想越气，手中拿着茶杯，心里盘算着怎样让岳千重知道厉害，乖乖地把剑奉上，禁不住一用力，茶杯捏得粉碎。这时正好进来一人，对韩猛说道：“庄主，小人有事禀报。”韩猛头也不动，知道此人正是他最得力的助手郭小三，说道：“讲！”
郭小三待韩猛回话之后，继续说道：“庄主，岳千重的儿子岳小同正在赌场里赌色子，陪他的姑娘是小桃红，属下来向你禀报之时，那岳小同已经输了五千两银子。”
韩猛一听，哈哈一笑，道：“好，你做得很好！”
韩猛自然清楚，岳小同刚到快活林之时便被快活林的弟兄盯上了，郭小三不仅变着法的安排让其赢了钱又输钱，而且还安排了一个让他输了钱都飘飘然然的女人。韩猛叫郭小三走到跟前，拍了拍肩膀以示嘉许，然后说道：“你等那岳小同输完钱之后再想办法借钱给他，他要多少给多少，另外再找几个兄弟和他打上一架。”
“小的明白。”郭小三听了命令转身走了。韩猛脸上露出了得意的微笑，他一向对郭小三的办事很放心，这次应该也不例外，他似乎已经看到鱼肠剑摆在了古董架上。
一个时辰之后，岳小同被五花大绑的带到韩猛面前，郭小三向韩猛禀道：“庄主，此人在我们赌场内闹事，输了钱还打人，好几个兄弟都受了伤，请当家的做主。”
韩猛面色一怒，对岳小同说道：“胆子不小，敢在快活林闹事，你可知道是什么后果？”
岳小同不知道自己进了一个圈套，忙道：“在下一时糊涂多有冒犯，还望庄主看在我爹面上多多包涵。”
“家父乃苍南剑客岳千重，请庄主网开一面。”岳小同连忙答道。
“原来是岳老先生的儿子。你父亲也算是我的熟识，只是这里的规矩不能坏了，既是熟人之后我便放你一马，免了你的皮肉之苦，不过得委屈你几天了，做做样子给下人们看看。”说完便示意郭小三把岳小同押了下去，关了起来。

> Chapter 4 Another Sword (Page 1)
There is a famous town called Qingsongpo in Kaifeng County, Henan. What makes Qingsongpo famous in the world is that there is a villa called "Happy Forest" here. If you want to have a good meal in Happy Forest, the dishes cooked by the chefs here will never be worse than those cooked by the Bafukuji Restaurant in Beijing. If you are looking for a woman, the women here are no worse than the girls in Suzhou Yihongyuan, and they even have other charms. Of course, there is also the largest casino here, which has everything, including dice, mahjong, Pai Gow, cockfighting, etc. Even chess can be played by people. In short, this happy forest is a first-class gold-selling cave for rich people.
Han Meng, the head of Happy Forest, was sitting on a Taishi chair, brewing a pot of tea, which was the finest Lu'an melon slices. He drank two cups, but his mood still did not improve. Han Meng has a hobby and likes to collect some rare antiques. Because he has money and status in the world, many people fawn on him and collect a lot of good things. As for the jade unicorn I bought ten days ago, it is completely green and is the best among jadeite. Especially the luminous pearl in the mouth, which is round and smooth and sparkles at night, illuminating a small room like daylight. It is extremely precious. Even the royal supervisor of the palace, Wang Gonggong, couldn't help but be amazed after seeing it, and even said it was rare!
However, there are also those who do not give face. I heard that Yue Qianzhong, a swordsman from Cangnan, had a "fish intestine sword" in his home. It was a rare weapon left over from the Spring and Autumn Period. Han Meng specially brought 100,000 taels of silver to buy it. Yue Qianzhong treated him warmly when he first arrived at his house, but when he heard that he wanted to buy a fish intestine sword, his expression changed and he said: "The fish intestine sword is a family heirloom, and I won't sell it for more money!" In the end, Han Meng parted on bad terms, and Han Meng returned angrily.
The more Han Meng thought about it, the angrier he became. He held the tea cup in his hand and was thinking about how to let Yue Qianzhong know how powerful he was. He obediently offered the sword to him. He couldn't help but squeeze the tea cup to pieces. At this time, someone happened to come in and said to Han Meng: "Master, I have something to report." Han Meng didn't move his head, knowing that this person was his most capable assistant Guo Xiaosan, and said: "Speak!"
After Guo Xiaosan waited for Han Meng's reply, he continued: "Master, Yue Qianzhong's son Yue Xiaotong is gambling in the casino, and the girl accompanying him is Xiao Taohong. When my subordinate came to report to you, Yue Xiaotong had already lost five thousand taels of silver."
When Han Meng heard this, he laughed and said, "Okay, you did a good job!"
Han Meng naturally knew that when Yue Xiaotong first arrived at Happy Forest, he was targeted by the brothers of Happy Forest. Guo Xiaosan not only made various arrangements to make him win and lose money, but also arranged a woman who made him feel happy even when he lost money. Han Meng asked Guo Xiaosan to come forward, patted his shoulder to show his approval, and then said: "Wait until Yue Xiaotong loses the money and then find a way to lend him as much money as he wants, and find a few brothers to fight with him."
"I understand, little one." Guo Xiaosan turned around and left after hearing the order. A proud smile appeared on Han Meng's face. He had always been reassured by Guo Xiaosan's work, and this time should be no exception. He seemed to have seen the fish intestine sword placed on the antique shelf.
An hour later, Yue Xiaotong was tied up and brought to Han Meng. Guo Xiaosan reported to Han Meng: "Master, this person is causing trouble in our casino. He beats people after losing money. Several brothers were injured. Please make the decision."
Han Meng's face became angry and he said to Yue Xiaotong: "You are very brave and dare to cause trouble in Happy Forest. Do you know what the consequences will be?"
Yue Xiaotong didn't know that he had fallen into a trap, so he hurriedly said: "It's very offensive if I am confused for a moment. I hope the owner of the village will forgive me for my father's sake."
"My father is Yue Qianzhong, the Cangnan swordsman. Please be kind to the village owner." Yue Xiaotong replied quickly.
"It turns out he is Mr. Yue's son. Your fatherYou can be considered an acquaintance of mine, but the rules here cannot be broken. Since we are acquaintances, I will let you go and spare you the pain of your flesh and blood. However, I will have to wrong you for a few days, just to show off to the servants. After saying that, he signaled Guo Xiaosan to take Yue Xiaotong down and lock him up.
